messages:
Avery: deploy-bot flagged staging promo BLOCKED due to e2e suite failures on canary run. looks like test grid timeouts + one asset upload partial.

ci-bot: PROMO_BLOCK staging canary v2026.4.10 -> v2026.4.11
checks: e2e-suite: 14/20 passed
failures: browser-login.spec.js x3 (selenium worker timeout), checkout-flow.spec.js x2 (element not found), asset-upload.spec.js x1 (partial upload 206)
logs: https://ci.internal/4412351234/canary/12

Lee: asset-upload 206 matches last week's transient S3 finalize 499s. but browser-login flakes point at selenium-grid instability. anyone seeing infra alerts?

ci-bot: INFRA_HEALTH: selenium-grid pool saw 4 worker restarts in last 2h. S3 us-east-1 increased 5xx between 10:02-10:12 UTC.

Pat: artifact registry shows v2026.4.11 pushed successfully. deploy job retried blob chunk 4 and observed a 206 response during multipart finalize. likely transient.

Avery: change window ends in 55m. Options: 1) pin to v2026.4.10 to keep cut, 2) revert uploader PR (revert 6f9a) and rebuild then rerun canary, 3) delay the cut. Product prefers not to delay.

Lee: revert is quick and low risk but requires new image and canary run which may exceed window. pin is fastest and consistent with past decisions.

Pat: agreed. I'll open a promo-pin PR and add release note explaining the pin and follow-up plan. Also open infra ticket for grid and S3 telemetry.

Avery: consensus: pin to v2026.4.10, manual promote, then hotfix pipeline for uploader if failures repro. Pat, please start PR and kick manual promote once merged.

Pat: PR created https://git.internal/repo/promo-pin/789. Release note draft: "Pin canary to v2026.4.10 due to transient infra-related e2e failures; Feature Y deferred to next patch. Contact @Avery."

deploy-bot: ACTION: promo pinned to v2026.4.10 (manual override) by Pat at 4412351340. Release window preserved.

qa-bot: follow-up: QA will re-run e2e after grid stabilization and verify asset-upload. will open ticket if failures persist.

Avery: thanks. Lee to own infra ticket, Pat to own pin PR and manual promote, QA to verify. closing thread.
